answer: Doubling registration fees price each new key off a public counter. The juniper registry charges a funder 2 POA for its first key and twice the previous fee for every key after, so key n costs 2^n POA. Each fee goes into a nectar pool paid only to other funders' keys, so a farm cannot refund itself. A delta check rejects any key whose balance history matches another key of the same funder by over 90%. Attacker pays 2,046 POA for 10 fakes this epoch (2+4+...+1,024).
